ridge_objective: mean squared training error plus lambda times sum of squared standardized slopes; intercept unpenalized; training population SD; no selection on losses
sample_policy: Unchanged LH1 monthly panels, missing calendar months, models, horizons, origins and matured-label training minimum; no new security/date intervals released
nonoverlap_policy: Every origin_grid modulo horizon phase; never select a favorable anchor; periods may share endpoints, no interior overlap within phase
drift_policy: Store raw and training-SD slopes at every LH1 origin; report first/last/range/sign transitions descriptively, without significance tests
evaluation: Exposed-history retrospective sensitivity, no prospective or causal validation
new_history_policy: Verify all three deliveries and qualify stable identity, exact venue, currency/units, status, split/ratio clocks and transitions before any extension; structural publication dates unknown remain retrospective
